# Test fixtures

All files in this directory are either self-authored for this project (MIT, same as the
plugin) or public-domain material, as listed below. They are committed so the test suite
and manual verification are reproducible offline.

## Self-authored (MIT, generated by the project)

| file | description |
|---|---|
| `note.md` | Chinese GFM document: YAML frontmatter, headings, bold/italic/inline code, external + `#anchor` links, blockquote, nested lists, task list, 3×3 table, fenced `js` code, inline and display math, Mermaid fence, local image reference, long-scroll sections. |
| `images/chart.png` | 480×240 chart drawn with Pillow, referenced by `note.md`/`report.docx`. |
| `report.docx` | Word document built with python-docx: Title + Heading 1/2/3 (Chinese), `Table Grid` table, embedded image + caption, external hyperlink, bullet list, 12 long paragraphs. |
| `sample.pdf` | Two-page PDF with a real text layer (each page contains the word `omnireader`), hand-written PDF objects/xref by `omnireader-tools/make-test-pdfs.py` (standard library only). |
| `scanned.pdf` | One-page PDF whose only content is a raster image (no text layer) — used to verify the reader reports zero search hits rather than inventing text. |
| `corrupt.epub` | Plain text with an `.epub` extension. |
| `corrupt.mobi` | 600 bytes of `0x07` with a `.mobi` extension. |
| `notes.txt` | Unsupported extension (`unsupported-format` path). |

## Public domain

| file | source | license |
|---|---|---|
| `book.epub` | Project Gutenberg ebook #84, *Frankenstein; Or, The Modern Prometheus* by Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley — `https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/84.epub.noimages` | Project Gutenberg License / public domain in the US |
| `book.mobi` | Same ebook, Kindle format without images — `https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/84.kindle.noimages` (resolves to `https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/84/pg84.mobi`) | Project Gutenberg License / public domain in the US |

## Not committed

- `dummy.pdf` (W3C PDF test file, `https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf`)
  and `tracemonkey.pdf` (Safari/Mozilla samples, `raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla/pdf.js/...`)
  were used only for live large-file checks during development; they are **not** part of the
  repository. Their third-party licenses do not cover redistribution here.

Fixture sizes are asserted nowhere; tests read whatever is on disk, so regenerating the
self-authored files is safe.
